sections.title: Rhyme time
sections.text:
Science
Science opens a window for humans.
With science, we can go farther.
With science, we can fly higher.
With science, we find out why apples fall to the ground.
With science, we now know why the earth goes around the sun.
Science helps us understand the world around us.
Science helps us explore outer space.
Science is cool. It’s really cool to be a scientist!

sections.title: Sound / Sounds
sections.text:
Sounds fl fly, pl explore.
The birds flap wings and fly so high. A plane can be like a bird and fly in the sky.

sections.title: Talking time
sections.text:
Look here! It’s Newton. Do you know the story of ‘Newton’s apple’?
Yes, I do. The story is like this. Young Newton was thinking about the universe under an apple tree. Suddenly an apple fell on his head.
He thought hard about the reasons for the fall of apples. And later he discovered the Law of Gravity.
Look, Qian Xuesen, a rocket scientist.
I’m a big fan of him. I’m also interested in outer space. I want to be a scientist like him in the future.
Your dream will come true.
Look at these photos of famous scientists.
Oh, this is Tu Youyou, a Nobel Prize winner.
Yes. What do you know about her?
She discovered qinghaosu and has saved many lives.
Wow. She is great!
Find the rule: This is Tu Youyou, a Nobel Prize winner. This is Qian Xuesen, a rocket scientist. This is Yuan Longping, the ‘Father of Hybrid Rice’.

sections.title: Reading time
sections.text:
Great scientists
Yuan Longping was born in Beijing in 1930. In the 1960s, as the nation was short of food, Mr Yuan began to do research on hybrid rice. He was creative and hard-working. His hybrid rice has fed many people. Mr Yuan is known as the ‘Father of Hybrid Rice’.
Alexander Graham Bell was born in Scotland in 1847. He was always curious about new things. He and his assistant Thomas Watson invented the world’s first practical telephone. Bell was interested in many research areas. He invented a lot of techniques to help the deaf.

A slide show of a great scientist
‘Grandpa of sugar pill’
Gu Fangzhou is a great scientist. He is known as the ‘Grandpa of sugar pill’. He created an oral vaccine against polio. It has saved many children in China.
